scope: Generic chosen-X non-targeted entry graveyard exile and exact-result counters/linking; retained-activation copy followup remains a separate engine task. No ordinary card definitions/admissions.

oracle.name: Mimeoplasm, Revered One
oracle.oracle_text:
As Mimeoplasm enters, exile up to X creature cards from your graveyard. It enters with three +1/+1 counters on it for each creature card exiled this way.
{2}: Mimeoplasm becomes a copy of target creature card exiled with it, except it's 0/0 and has this ability.

semantics: All copied-blueprint replacements finish before the entry-exile phase. Choose up to X own graveyard cards incrementally without targeting; simultaneous not-yet-present entrants are unavailable.
Selected identities remain exact. Only actual successful Exile ZoneChange results produce counters and links; the link source is the exact successfully entered incarnation.
Counters enter the existing intrinsic entry counter pipeline before doubling/prohibition. The actual successful exile count is captured once.
Funding enumerates completions of the chosen prefix and applies the same movement success/prohibition checks. Zero selections remain legal.

Existing true GraveyardCardsCannotBeExiled prohibition had been cost-only; common actual effect planning now stops the prohibited event before replacement selection, and projected departures agree. Prohibited activation costs remain unavailable.

validation.Cargo: No Cargo by author; root guarded build/scenarios pending.
